I replied to Kwame in your DM. I did not set up the recurring digest.

I told him that I have no way to deliver a scheduled 09:00 message to his DM. Scheduled jobs from this session stay local, so nothing would reach him. I offered two alternatives: I can post a digest of #coastal-team on request, or he can set a daily 09:00 calendar reminder to ask. I did not read #coastal-team or create any calendar entry or job.
